name: Artisan Plaza Farmers' Market
description: Artisan Plaza Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 1233 4th St S, MN, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
